PASS A — TWO MECHANISMS (both inside the allowed SIGNAL-QUALITY lever family; the v16 record bans all relocation, and under committed FCCS the CLIP curve never seeds candidates — pipeline.py L1723-1740 sets clip_regions=[] — so curve work can only move boundaries, while candidate recall work must act on the FCCS VLM scan itself).

=== P1: PW-TC — Temporal-Contrast re-fit of the per-category CLIP prompt weights (curve query quality) ===
Root cause: the v93/v94 prompt_weights.json were trained with a VIDEO-LEVEL MIL top-k loss (anomaly_expert.py L180-233); nothing optimizes IN-VIDEO temporal prominence, hence the measured flat in-span curves on Shoplifting/RoadAccidents (v157). Mechanism: re-fit the 6-prompt weight vector per flat category with a weakly-supervised TEMPORAL objective on TRAIN-split videos only (video-level labels; train split has NO frame GT — verified: 0/29 Shoplifting train rows annotated): maximize top-decile prominence (topk_mean - median)/MAD of the pipeline-exact cat/(cat+normal) curve on anomaly videos of that category, minus the same prominence on Training_Normal videos, with an entropy/KL regularizer toward the committed weights to prevent one-hot collapse.
Touch-points: prompt_weights.json only (a new weights file loaded by anomaly_expert._precompute_text_features, L197-223) — text embeddings computed once and cached; zero pipeline code-path change. Downstream consumers: frame_scorer.get_category_scores (frame_scorer.py L41-61) → Stage-5 _clip_boundary_detection (pipeline.py L1826), Stage-7b clip_score_curve_correction (L1889), BUE (L1293), CBT. Effect channel: BETTER CURVE LOCALIZATION only (boundaries of already-proposed candidates); CANNOT touch Shoplifting CAND-MISS because the curve does not seed candidates under FCCS. Latency: ~zero (one-time text encode).

=== P2: KFD-U — Uniform-spread keyframes in the FCCS comparative scan (candidate recall via scan-frame quality) ===
Root cause (found this session, code-exact): for every 6s segment, _sample_keyframes (anomaly_discovery.py L45-56) routes to SemanticFrameSampler.select_keyframes (token_compressor.py L78-133), whose target K=ceil(6s*fps_sample=3.0)=18 >= the 12 frames a 2fps segment contains, so ALL ~12 ordered frames are returned — and then _comparative_call (anomaly_discovery.py L110-113) TRUNCATES to keyframes[:keyframes_per_segment], i.e. the FIRST 2 frames (t+0.0s, t+0.5s), or the first 1 (t+0.0s) under the >60-segment long-video rule. Semantic dedup only shrinks the pre-truncation pool (static segments collapse to their earliest cluster), so the VLM's evidence for each 6s segment is at best its leading ~0.5s. A brief event (RoadAccidents GT 2-3s; Shoplifting GT 2-7s, measured from the parquet) that starts mid-segment is literally never shown to the VLM — a structural CAND-MISS generator, exactly the v16 residual (Shoplifting 11/25). Mechanism: replace the first-k truncation with a deterministic uniform spread over the segment: k=2 -> frames at {t_start, t_start+3.0s}; long-video 1-kf rule -> segment midpoint. Same segment grid, same batch sizes (8x2 / 16x1), same frames/call (16), same call count, same prompts, same thresholds/merge/top-k.
Touch-points: ONE line region — anomaly_discovery.py L110-113 in _comparative_call (used by both scan_full_coverage L517-519 via _scan_comparative_batch_guarded L440-452 and scan_segments_comparative); new DiscoveryConfig flag kfd_uniform_keyframes (default OFF; flag-off keeps the exact truncation path -> byte-identical), CLI in BOTH run.py and batch_evaluate.py; markers KFD-FIRE (per batch where the spread changes selected indices) + unconditional per-video KFD-VID on ALL return paths incl. 0-detection and early-return-normal (FM17, mirror the CNV call sites pipeline.py L1658/L1787/L2129). Effect channel: RECALL VIA NEW CANDIDATES (the GT frame becomes visible to the comparative judgment). Latency: zero (identical frames/call and call count).

PASS B — ATTACKS.
On P1: (1) My own offline numbers kill the naive form: a PW-TC-lite train refit COLLAPSED to one-hot (Shoplifting weight on prompt #6 = 0.9995) and transferred with mixed sign (Shoplifting z_in deltas +0.413/-0.068/-0.345/+0.875, mean +0.219 but peak-in-GT LOST on Shoplifting033; RoadAccidents -0.012/-0.137, both worse). (2) The best-single-prompt oracle shows headroom (mean z_in +1.389 vs committed +0.250) but the winning prompt INDEX is inconsistent across videos within a category (Shop: 6,2,4,3/6; RA: 2,3), so no fixed per-category weight vector can capture it. (3) FM6 curse is realized twice in this family: v15 CGR offline +0.019 did not transfer; v159 PMX offline-promising max-pool REGRESSED RoadAccidents -0.128 online. My table reproduces the trap: PMX max-pool IMPROVES RoadAccidents offline (z_in +0.639/+0.637 vs committed +0.252/-0.274) — the exact configuration measured-negative online. Offline curve gains can invert online. (4) Ceiling: even a perfect curve only feeds boundary stages, and BUE already realized +0.0378 of the +0.0764 best-of-two boundary oracle; P1's addressable residual excludes the biggest term (CAND-MISS). (5) Harness reality: any boundary-side gain would be ~+0.01, inside the +/-0.012 @290 noise floor. REFINEMENT attempted: scope to Shoplifting-only + regularized fit + offline pre-gate — still fails my pre-registered "uniformly non-worse transfer on the 6-video probe" offline gate. P1 is REJECTED by its own diagnostic (see precheck).
On P2: (1) Coverage is necessary, not sufficient — the VLM may still not flag a subtle concealment from sparse stills (v143 proved VLM judgment issues); the flag link is untestable offline and is the designated online question. (2) Symmetric-loss risk: re-spreading frames changes EVERY segment's evidence, not just GT segments; current leading-edge frames may accidentally carry drama that drives today's correct detections (offline arithmetic cannot measure this). (3) Effect size: +7 newly GT-covered hard-cat videos at constant cost; realistic conversion 2-4 videos -> +0.01-0.02 global mAP, at the 88-video cross-run floor (v159 measured +-0.0115 Shoplifting drift on an UNTOUCHED category) — the paired-log instrument CANNOT be used (VLM inputs change; no deterministic replay), so the gate must absorb cross-run noise. (4) k=3 placement achieves 44/44 coverage but +50% scan tokens and a changed 8x3 batch geometry — kept as a non-winner arm; the k=2 constant-cost form is the cleanest test of the mechanism. P2 SURVIVES the attacks weakened but intact: it is the only proposal whose addressable residual IS the v16 headline residual, its cost is zero, and its failure mode is a measurable null, not a measured harm.
